mechanism: Pair exact-expiry listed equity-option verticals with strict Pyth close-above tokens using an outward strike shift derived from a frozen Pyth-versus-option-settlement basis bound.

required_external_input.feed: licensed real-time OPRA top-of-book with source and receive timestamps
required_external_input.acceptable_adapter: read-only IBKR Client Portal market data with the user's entitled subscription
required_external_input.exact_basis_sources: Pyth final regular-session one-minute candle plus official primary-listing close
required_external_input.prohibited: automated extraction of delayed quote webpages or relabeling broker last prices as settlement evidence

hard_vetoes: option expiry date is not exactly the Polymarket settlement date
Pyth rule, comparator, tie treatment or feed symbol is uncertified
fewer than 30 untouched Pyth-versus-official close basis days
regular-session trading has not been observed
missing option commission, exchange fee, tick stress or assignment reserve
missing source timestamp, receive timestamp or displayed option size
non-atomic orphan reserve erases the residual

cost_model.polymarket: walk full ask depth with current fee schedule at two-times stress
cost_model.options: buy ask minus sell bid, two-times commissions, one tick per option leg
cost_model.leg_risk: worst immediate unwind across every proper subset of the three legs

null_outcome: Synchronized option costs, basis reserve and orphan risk may erase every apparent residual.
